# Data Exploration

Once data is clean, the next step is asking it questions. The project below digs into a normalized baseball database using window functions and CTEs to surface trends a flat query couldn't easily show.

- [Baseball Analytics Engine — Query Layer](Cleansing_Exploration/project1.qmd) — rolling averages, RBI efficiency, and league rankings pulled out of a relational baseball database
